mapper.select: SELECT stu_id AS stuId, stu_name AS stuName FROM t_mst_student WHERE del_flg = 0 ORDER BY stu_name
SELECT DISTINCT subject_id AS subjectId, subject_name AS subjectName FROM v_latest_subject_info_from_student_document WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY subject_id

SELECT lsn.lesson_id AS lessonId, fee.lsn_fee_id AS lsnFeeId, lsn.lesson_type AS lessonType, lsn.stu_id AS stuId, lsn.subject_id AS subjectId, lsn.schedual_date AS schedualDate, mst.stu_name AS stuName FROM t_info_lesson lsn INNER JOIN t_info_lesson_fee fee ON lsn.lesson_id = fee.lesson_id INNER JOIN t_mst_student mst ON lsn.stu_id = mst.stu_id WHERE lsn.stu_id = #{stuId} AND lsn.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND lsn.lesson_type = 1 AND lsn.scanqr_date IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(lsn.schedual_date, 7) = #{yearMonth} AND fee.del_flg = 0 ORDER BY lsn.lesson_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_info_lesson SET lesson_type = 2, update_date = NOW() WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_info_lesson_fee ( lsn_fee_id, lesson_id, lsn_month, lsn_fee, own_flg, del_flg ) SELECT #{newLsnFeeId}, #{lessonId}, lsn_month, lsn_fee, own_flg, del_flg FROM t_info_lesson_fee WHERE lsn_fee_id = #{srcLsnFeeId} AND lesson_id = #{lessonId}
